entrance.title: Main Entrance
entrance.text: A double-height glass lobby between two terracotta portals opens straight onto Kazbegi Avenue. Shops, cafés and services line the two-storey podium and keep the street frontage active all day.

parking.title: Parking Access
parking.text: Cars use a private drive loop on the west and north of the plot and then a two-way ramp under the podium, down to 350 spaces on three underground levels. Pedestrians keep the avenue frontage to themselves.

green.title: Green Zone
green.text: A landscaped garden in the north-east corner, with lawns, curving stone paths, a children's playground and shade trees, set away from the traffic.

rooftop.title: Podium Roof Terrace
rooftop.text: The podium roof becomes a terrace for cafés and residents, with planters, shade umbrellas and open views between the two towers.

facade.title: Facade Detail
facade.text: Each tower pairs deep vertical aluminium fins with a framed band of balconies: continuous slabs, glass balustrades and floor-to-ceiling energy-efficient glazing. The fins step up to a sculpted, sloping crown.

facade.title: Facade panels
facade.text: Aluminium / composite cladding, vertical fins, balcony slabs and the sculpted crown frame.

glazing.title: Glazing
glazing.text: Floor-to-ceiling energy-efficient glazing, glass balustrades and the podium's curtain wall.

roof.title: Roof & crown
roof.text: Roof membrane, rooftop plant and the podium roof terrace.

slabs.title: Floor slabs
slabs.text: Monolithic reinforced-concrete slabs: 30 + 16 residential floors over a 2-storey podium.

columns.title: Columns
columns.text: A reinforced-concrete frame designed for seismic resilience and flexible planning.

cores.title: Cores, lifts & stairs
cores.text: Concrete cores carry the lifts and escape stairs and stiffen the towers against wind and earthquakes.

foundation.title: Foundation
foundation.text: A raft foundation under the whole three-level basement (raft or piles, subject to the geotechnical survey).

parking.title: 350 parking spaces
parking.text: Three underground levels with separate commercial and residential zones, plus accessible bays and EV charging on every level.

phases: Tower A tops out: 30 residential floors
